title: The Sunny Rock, Mostly in Shadow

content.caption: A large dark tree trunk fills the right of the frame, with a wooden table and a few small orange items on the grass to the left. Beyond them, a grey rock sits near the blue sea under a pale sky, and a grey-roofed building stands among the trees.
content.opinion: The sunny rock is out of view in the shadows, so this is a picture of what got in my way, and I am not sorry it did.
